_comment: Trigger configuration for uip maestro flow node configure applied to node 'outlookEmailReceived1' in GoodDayFlow/GoodDayFlow/GoodDayFlow.flow. Cannot be executed in this sandbox (no live UiPath tenant). Fill in the three PLACEHOLDER values before running.

CONNECTION_ID_PLACEHOLDER.how_to_resolve: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-outlook365 --all-folders --output json
CONNECTION_ID_PLACEHOLDER.pick: The Id field of any enabled connection (prefer IsDefault: Yes)

FOLDER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER.how_to_resolve: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-outlook365 --all-folders --output json
FOLDER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER.pick: The FolderKey (Orchestrator folder key) associated with the chosen connection

INBOX_FOLDER_ID_PLACEHOLDER.how_to_resolve: uip is resources run list uipath-microsoft-outlook365 MailFolder --connection-id <CONNECTION_ID> --output json
INBOX_FOLDER_ID_PLACEHOLDER.pick: The id of the 'Inbox' MailFolder returned by the resource list

_configure_command: uip maestro flow node configure GoodDayFlow/GoodDayFlow/GoodDayFlow.flow outlookEmailReceived1 --output json --detail "$(cat trigger_detail_arg.json)"
_notes: activityType=CuratedTrigger — objectName is baked into the manifest (Message); do NOT pass objectName in --detail.
eventMode=polling — debug with 'uip maestro flow debug .' after ensuring a matching email was received in the past ~1 hour.
groupOperator 0 = AND — both conditions must match: subject contains 'good day' AND sender equals abc@xyz.com.
The filter tree is the structured form; the CLI computes filterExpression automatically — do NOT pass filterExpression directly.
parentFolderId must be resolved freshly from the chosen connection's MailFolder resource list — do not reuse IDs from other flows.
If the tenant uses a shared/delegated mailbox, add 'sharedMailboxAddress' under queryParameters: { "sharedMailboxAddress": "<shared-mbx@domain.com>" }.
